answer_raw:
The newest iPhone is the **iPhone Duo** [1].

As of October 2026, Apple has not released the retail price for the iPhone Duo, so you would need to check the Apple Store for current pricing [1].

Upgrading from an iPhone 14 to the latest model is a significant leap, especially since the iPhone 14 is now considered a budget-tier legacy device [2]. While the iPhone 14 remains a capable device for budget-conscious users with its A15 Bionic performance and OLED screen [3], the newer generations offer substantial improvements in battery life and display technology [8]. 

If you are looking for a direct comparison to the iPhone 14, the following table outlines the generational shifts:

| Feature | iPhone 14 | iPhone s-series / Duo (Latest) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Status** | Budget-tier legacy device [2] | Current flagship lineup [1] |
| **Performance** | A15 Bionic [3] | Latest Apple silicon [1] |
| **Primary Value** | High price-to-performance for budget users [5] | Cutting-edge features and app experiences [1] |

The decision to upgrade depends on your needs; if you want the latest features and maximum battery life, the move to the newest generation is worthwhile, whereas staying with the iPhone 14 is a viable option if you only need a dependable, budget-friendly device [3][6].
